project_type: Turborepo monorepo: Next.js 14 App Router web dashboard (apps/web), Expo React Native mobile (apps/mobile), shared TS package (packages/shared, @fundo360/shared), Supabase (Postgres 15 + RLS, Storage, Edge Functions in supabase/).
build_system: npm workspaces + Turborepo. Root scripts delegate to turbo: `npm run build` -> `turbo build`, `npm test` -> `turbo test`. packages/shared builds with tsc; apps/web with next build; apps/mobile with expo typecheck. @fundo360/shared is consumed by both apps and must build FIRST (turbo handles ^build ordering).
test_framework: Vitest, only in packages/shared (script `vitest --run`). Existing tests: packages/shared/src/types/dispatch.test.ts and picking-payment.test.ts. No test runner wired for apps in this task's scope; apps are verified by build/typecheck.
build_command: npm run build (from worktree root). Per-package: `cd packages/shared && npx tsc --noEmit`.
test_command: npm test (root) OR `cd packages/shared && npx vitest --run`.
verification_instructions: 1) Build the shared contract first: from worktree root `npm run build` (or `cd packages/shared && npx tsc --noEmit`). 2) Run shared unit tests: `cd packages/shared && npx vitest --run`. 3) Apply the migration locally: `npx supabase db reset` (REQUIRES Rancher Desktop running in `dockerd (moby)` engine mode; the Supabase CLI talks to docker.sock, see .kiro/steering/local-env.md). After reset wait ~40s; `bash scripts/seed-users.sh` creates test users (TEST_USERS.md). 4) For web/mobile changes, `npm run build` must pass (next build + expo typecheck). 5) Visual check web: toggle the org override of `payment_photo_evidence` ON, register a payment with photos and confirm thumbnails; flag OFF hides the block and payment still works.
snapshot_or_generated_files: None required by this task. Docs tooling exists (tbls -> `npm run db:docs`, mkdocs) but regenerating DB docs is optional; the only doc edit required is the flags catalog table in .kiro/steering/feature-flags.md.
environment_constraints: macOS. Container runtime is Rancher Desktop + nerdctl (NOT Docker Desktop); Supabase CLI needs Rancher in `dockerd (moby)` mode or `supabase start/db reset` fails. macOS has no `timeout` command. If db reset can't run (Rancher down), record the migration SQL as written and verify by inspection + reviewer note; do NOT block the whole task on local Supabase. Work ONLY inside the worktree /Users/ericksegura/Documents/backupHDD/personal/control-picking/.worktrees/pago-imagenes using absolute paths; relative paths land in the parent workspace. Branch: feature/pago-imagenes. Commit locally; never push.
contribution_requirements: Conventional Commits (type(scope): desc; scopes include payments, infra). TypeScript strict, no `any` (use unknown + guards). Code/identifiers in English; UI strings and business docs in Spanish; comments in English. DB tables snake_case plural, columns snake_case, UUID PKs. Migrations: timestamp > 20261005000003 (use 20261006000001); every FK indexed; multi-tenant tables carry organization_id + set_organization_id trigger + composite tenant FKs + RLS. New user-facing features MUST sit behind a feature flag wired in all 3 layers (catalog seed + code consumption + admin panel auto-renders). Update the flags catalog table in .kiro/steering/feature-flags.md when adding a flag (documentation rule).
domain_invariants_respected: The photo never alters payments.amount or any calculation (evidence is a separate table with no money columns). settlements stay immutable when paid: prevent_paid_settlement_update is untouched and evidence never writes settlements. RBAC enforced via RLS (write only is_admin/is_supervisor/is_crew_lead, scoped by org, uploaded_by=current_worker_id()). Entity naming correct: payments, workers, settlements, new payment_photo_evidence. picking_records and rates are NOT touched (picking quantity>0 and rate>0 invariants are out of this feature's path).
key_patterns: Payments are inserted CLIENT-DIRECT via supabase.from('payments').insert(...) in both web (CreatePaymentForm) and mobile (payModal mutation); they do NOT use the payments Edge Function. So evidence follows the same client-direct model as picking_photo_evidence: upload to Storage + INSERT the evidence row via SDK; RLS is the primary security layer. NO new/modified Edge Function. Precedents to mirror EXACTLY: migration 20261002000001 (private bucket + storage.objects policies + flag seed), migration 20261005000002 dispatch_receipts (separate 1:N table with composite tenant FKs, uq_<table>_id_org, set_organization_id trigger, RLS by role+org). Mobile camera: reuse PhotoCapture component (expo-camera, OTA-friendly, no native rebuild) wired like apps/mobile/app/(tabs)/register.tsx; evidence lib mirrors apps/mobile/src/lib/picking-evidence.ts (currentOrgId reads org_id from JWT claim; newUuid via expo-crypto; path {org_id}/{id}/{uuid}.jpg; private bucket + createSignedUrl). Feature flag resolution: useFeatureFlag(key) hook exists in both apps/web/src/hooks/useFeatureFlag.ts and apps/mobile/src/hooks/useFeatureFlag.ts (TanStack Query, resolveFeatureFlag from @fundo360/shared). Web admin panel apps/web/src/app/(platform)/platform/feature-flags/page.tsx is data-driven (no code change needed for a new flag).
